description: This file is a Perl script for managing package metadata within an OpenWRT build system. It includes functions for version comparison, Kconfig overrides, dependency resolution, package configuration, and output generation in various formats such as JSON and CycloneDX SBOM. The script interacts with package data, generating configuration files, source information, license details, and dependency lists.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string like '1.2.3' into a numerical representation for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on the comparison version and operators.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates Kconfig override entries based on package and build system configurations.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a specific package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion while checking package dependencies.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines whether one package depends on another.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration lines for a package's dependancies.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict dependency lines for packages.

methods.name: add_implicit_provides_conflicts
methods.description: Adds conflict entries for packages that provide the same virtual package.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs package configuration options grouped by category with dependencies.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs the package override configuration options.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates the full package configuration menu including categories and dependencies.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Creates a combined AND condition string for configs.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts logical conditions into makefile-compatible expressions.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependencies with conditionals based on build options.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates makefile entries for package build dependencies and variants.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs package source file information.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables like repository and provides.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs package license information, optionally including license files.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Filters and outputs a list of version strings based on a patch version.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs the user and group allocations for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON array of package metadata including dependencies and maintainers.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Parses an image manifest file to extract listed packages.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Constructs and encodes a CycloneDX SBOM JSON object.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON for an image's packages.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON for individual packages listed in a manifest.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command line options and executes subcommands for generating various package metadata formats.
